title: Getting to Know You
content:
Emma and Leo are sitting at a café after work.

“Can I ask you something?” Leo says.

“Of course!” Emma replies.

“**Do you like coffee?**”

“Yes, I do! I love coffee. What about you?”

“I do too, but I prefer tea.”

Emma smiles.

“**Do you like Italian food?**”

“Yes, I do. Pizza is my favorite!”

“Really? I prefer Japanese food,” Emma says.

Leo looks surprised.

“**Do you like sushi?**”

“Yes, I love it!”

The waiter comes to their table.

“What would you like to drink?” he asks.

“I'd like a coffee, please,” Emma says.

“And I'd like a tea,” Leo says.

While they wait, Emma asks another question.

“**Do you like movies?**”

“Yes, I do! My favorite movies are comedies. What about you?”

“I like movies too, but I prefer books.”

Leo smiles.

“So, we have different preferences.”

“Yes,” Emma says. “But that's a good thing.”

Leo laughs.

“I agree. It gives us more things to talk about!”
